{
  "shaderlod-display.service": "[Unit]
Description=ShaderLOD GPU-backed virtual display

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=@REPOSITORY@
Environment=XDG_CONFIG_HOME=@REPOSITORY@/.local/display/config
Environment=XDG_DATA_HOME=@REPOSITORY@/.local/display/data
Environment=XDG_CACHE_HOME=@REPOSITORY@/.local/cache
Environment=MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR=@REPOSITORY@/.local/cache/mesa
Environment=XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=ShaderLOD
Environment=QT_NO_XDG_DESKTOP_PORTAL=1
UnsetEnvironment=DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY XAUTHORITY
RuntimeDirectory=shaderlod-display
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
ExecStart=/usr/bin/dbus-run-session -- /usr/bin/kwin_wayland --virtual --width 2560 --height 1600 --scale 1 --output-count 1 --xwayland --socket wayland-shaderlod --no-lockscreen --no-global-shortcuts --no-kactivities "--exit-with-session=/usr/bin/python3 -m shaderlod_host display-publish"
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/python3 -m shaderlod_host display-check --timeout 30
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStartSec=45
TimeoutStopSec=15

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
",
  "shaderlod-lid.service": "[Unit]
Description=Keep the ShaderLOD development host awake when its lid closes

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemd-inhibit --no-ask-password --what=handle-lid-switch --mode=block --who=ShaderLOD "--why=Headless development: ignore lid close" /usr/bin/sleep infinity
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
"
}
